newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS lowers Ascend to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS lowers Ascend to hold.

text.p: UBS Securities analyst Nikos Theodosopoulos said Tuesday he had lowered Ascend Communications Inc from a buy to a hold rating, reflecting near-term risk.
-- said was downgrading based on view that the company may
be faced with a material financial obligation of free
customer upgrades to workable 56 kb/s modem cards for the MAX and TNT units.
-- said would reconsider the hold rating given a better
understanding of the potential liability of the free 56 kb/s upgrade or after reviewing positive second quarter 1997 results.
-- said longer-term prospects remain good for the company
given solid demand for remote access and new GRF product line.
Ascend fell 3-1/2 to 44-1/8 in morning trade.
